title: Craftable Items
description: Craftable Items is a Minecraft mod that lets players craft items and blocks that normally cannot be crafted in vanilla Minecraft. It adds new recipes for uncraftable things, making survival gameplay more fun, useful, and creative.
body:
Craftable Items is a simple and useful Minecraft mod that allows you to craft items and blocks that are normally uncraftable in vanilla Minecraft.

No more relying on commands or creative mode — now you can obtain rare and special items through survival gameplay! we will add more items that are uncraftable soon in the future!
